main_text.p: fine eft instituta,ut recordationem eam exuscita-ret,atque aleret in animis nostris. Canō Syno di Nicenæ. Q.1Id quod ut fusius, ita clarius exponit Canon græcus qui Nicenæ synodo ascribitur. Eum tu quidem citas, sed ut regeras in aduersarios. quod dum facis,stomacharis in eos acriter,ac conuiciis atrocissimis cō suetam calumniam adiungis: quasi Canon ab ipsis proferatur ad corporis præsentiam euertenda.

Oporteret sane eum stipite esse, qui id faceret, cū verbis disertis sit ascriptum :Preciosum corpus & sanguinem fumetes,&c. At enim producitur pie & apposite, ad corrigendas cogitationes crassas & carneas, non illas quidem omnino tales atq; Capernaitarum (nam Christo ab oculis subducto prorsus tales esse nequeunt) verum quæ ad eas proximè accedunt. Id profecto est quod dicitur, IN PRO POSITVM PANEM,& calicem humiliter intenti nosimus: sed mente in altum sublata, side cogitemus in hac sacra men-sa,&c. Athanaf. In dictum Christi, Quicunq; dixerit verbum,&c.Confirmat hoc ipsum præclara illa Atha-nasij termaximi sententia: Hac de causa ascensionis in coelum filij hominis meminit, ut corporalem cogitationem ab illis auelleret:& posthac discerent, carnem de qua fuerat lo-cutus, cibum e supernis coelestem, spiritualem alimoniam ab i-pso dari. Hoc testimonii cū excutis, negas ascen-sionem in coelum opponi præsentiæ quę in cœna est: Q.3sed craffam Capernaitarum imaginationem refutari ais:& te modum statuere arcanū,incom-prehensibilem,planeq; diuinum affirmas. verum qui potest esse talis, nisi qui per spiritum & fidem sit? Quàm ista procul absunt ab illis etiā tuis,Ore corporis sumitur, sed labiis non attingitur!&c.
Huius generis multa tu recitas quidē, sed clausis oculis præteris, moxq; te alio conuertis. Et cū

In dictum Christi, Quicunq; dixerit verbum,&c." are placed at their nearest text point; the "Q.3" marginal mark is placed beside the line "est: sed craffam". The printed "Q.1"/"Q.3" marks are read as they appear; their placement is approximate. Long s was read as s throughout, and words broken across lines were joined with the printed hyphen where one was printed. Doubtful readings: "termaximi" (Athanasii maximi?) and "Atha-nasij", "arcanū", and "labiis" (printed "labijs"); the first three are reproduced as the scan appears and are unverified. "stomacharis" is joined from "ftoma / charis" without a printed hyphen.
